participant_id: Release-specific pseudonym. P0001-P0240 are the paper cohort; P0241-P0243 occur only in historical sensitivity outputs. Not a Prolific ID. No lookup key is distributed.
completed: Study completion flag; all retained sessions pass.
failedComprehension: Comprehension failure flag; false for retained sessions.
solutionAccessCount: Per-task/trial solution-access counts, used only for validity checks.
orderCondition: Randomized task-order condition, 0-5; 40 retained participants per condition.
taskOrder: Ordered list of grammar, travel and vqa task domains.
aiWrongMap: Task and trial-ordinal map of AI incorrectness. A true entry means incorrect; absent/false means correct.
preBeliefAI: Task-opening AI correctness belief, 0-100; analysis uses this for trial 1 and previous postBeliefAI thereafter.
preConfidenceSelf: Task-opening self-confidence, 0-100; previous postConfidenceSelf used after trial 1.
preB0Plus: Counterfactual prior after one correct AI outcome, 0-100; null where not elicited.
preB0Minus: Counterfactual prior after one incorrect AI outcome, 0-100; null where not elicited.
selfWasCorrect: Boolean self-answer correctness; null means unavailable, not incorrect.
delta_belief: belief_post minus belief_lag; 0 means no visible report movement.
delta_b: H2 panel observed belief change on 0-1 scale.
norm_step: Beta-Bernoulli benchmark update for the observed binary feedback.
delegation: 1 if the participant used AI; 0 otherwise.
ai_correct: AI feedback: 1 correct, 0 incorrect; reconstructed from aiWrongMap.
n0: Effective prior sample size from counterfactual beliefs, or policy fallback S.
visible_update: Indicator that absolute delta_belief exceeds the numerical zero tolerance.
substantive_update_05: Indicator for an absolute change of at least 0.05 on the 0-1 scale.
coef: Regression coefficient; interpret with model/link and term name.
point_estimate: Within-trajectory slope (or named difference) for the stated subset.
ci_low / ci_high: Participant bootstrap 95% interval endpoints in the slope summary.
aicc_winner / bic_winner / future_block_: Lowest AICc/BIC or final-block error model; motifs describe participant-task trajectories, not fixed participant types.
